name: Hasegawa
source:
Estimated Age: Around 29 years old

The personal secretary and bodyguard of the president of the "River Og" company
He's methodical, serious, and extremely taciturn. A rare for these times hardliner.
He's often misunderstood because of his looks, but he actually has a kind heart.
